name: cancelOrder
description: Cancel an order and refund its amount, after the person at the keyboard explicitly confirms. Only PLACED or PAID orders can be cancelled. Requires the mcp:tools:write scope. If the confirmation is declined, nothing is written and the result is REJECTED_BY_USER, not an error.

orderId.description: The order id, for example O-9001.

reason.description: Why the order is being cancelled, shown to the person confirming it.
